explication: Euro-Office Desktop Editors is a cross-platform desktop frontend for an offline-capable office suite, with optional cloud collaboration. The user-facing path is launch, choose or connect to a document source, then open a document in an editor window; the editing and conversion engine lives in a separate repository. The tree shows a substantial Windows/Linux shell and shared login-page UI, while macOS entries are headers only. Edges are limited to README statements and sampled/indexed references; unsampled UI and platform behavior is represented conservatively.
